description: Per-SDK support level for each conformance plan. Runners read this matrix to skip plans that are not applicable to the SDK under test.

levels.optional: Tested when the operation is implemented; failures do not block SDK certification.
levels.required: Must pass for the SDK to be considered conformant at this capability.
levels.skip: Not applicable to this SDK (operation not exposed or not implemented by the SDK, or plan slice wrong for SDK type).

plans.name: diff
plans.notes: Required of the reference SDK; optional for the others.

plans.name: scope-transport
plans.notes: Assertion-state transport across the projection boundary against ref-scope-1 (default-scope + alternate-scope + capture-value categories). Covers process/render carrying scope-only and mixed sets, subset-format render at the coverage boundary, capture-value byte-preservation, and aggregateAssertions over scoped + capture sets. Embed SDKs ship the JS engine so they pass automatically; client SDKs pass once they implement the aggregateAssertions wire method, so the plan is optional for them.

plans.name: evaluate-guide
plans.notes: Covers evaluateGuide, evaluateMany, and guideScan methods.

plans.name: from-layers
plans.notes: Per-request layer composition (SchemeEngine.fromLayers). No HTTP endpoint is exposed; client SDKs always receive a pre-composed scheme from the server.

plans.name: registry
plans.notes: SchemeRegistry multi-scheme operations. Optional for non-reference SDKs.

plans.name: surfaces
plans.notes: Outputs declared by surface and view against ref-surfaces-1: recognition reports the view the text is read as and its role, never the form it happened to be read in; a read-only form reads as its view and stands for it as an output; a view id names what the text is read as and reads it in the forms that view writes, its case forms included, never in its read-only form; text the engine writes on two surfaces reads back uncorrected; an unnamed output follows the role; a wrapper makes a part; text read as a view of the role the request's context does not name departs from it, unless the request names the view.

plans.name: ctx-process
plans.notes: Context-based operations (ctxProcess, ctxScan, ctxDocumentAudit). Requires a live REST API server with a contexts file. Embed SDKs resolve ctx server-side; client SDKs call /api/ctx/* directly.

sdks.description: Java embed SDK: ships the JS engine bundle and exposes a Java API
.NET embed SDK: ships the JS engine bundle and exposes a .NET API; runs the engine-slice conformance plans
Python embed SDK: ships the JS engine bundle and exposes a Python API; runs the engine-slice conformance plans
Go HTTP client SDK: calls the REST API; no engine bundle
